profile.name: Kshitij Desai
profile.title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
profile.summary: Senior Security Operations Analyst with over 7 years of combined IT and Cybersecurity experience, specializing in threat detection engineering, SIEM/EDR management, and automated incident response. Proven track record of technical leadership, having mentored and trained 10+ junior analysts to mid-tier proficiency through structured shadow sessions and hands-on skill development. Expert in authoring custom threat hunting queries using KQL and CrowdStrike LogScale CQL, optimizing detection rule logic, and driving Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) across AWS and Azure environments. Certified Blue Team Level 1 (Gold) professional skilled in building automated SOC playbooks, integrating threat intelligence via APIs, and executing high-fidelity alert tuning to bridge Security Operations and Security Engineering.

roles.title: Sr. Security Operations Analyst
bullets: Lead threat detection tuning, advanced triage escalations, and cross-functional security engineering initiatives across global environments
Mentor and train 10+ junior security analysts through structured shadowing, technical training sessions, and targeted career pathing
Engineer and refine SIEM and EDR/XDR detection rules within Microsoft Sentinel and CrowdStrike Falcon, reducing false-positive alert volume
Execute proactive threat hunting campaigns across multi-cloud and hybrid endpoints utilizing custom KQL and LogScale CQL queries
Design and maintain automated SOC response playbooks and SOPs to streamline incident triage, investigation, and escalation workflows

roles.title: Security Operations Analyst
bullets: Conducted cloud vulnerability and misconfiguration audits using CSPM tools (Wiz and Aqua Security)
Performed deep-dive root cause analysis on high-severity phishing, malware, and credential harvesting campaigns
Validated security impact of externally reported vulnerabilities, coordinating patch deployment and remediation tracking
Correlated network firewall logs across Cisco Meraki and Palo Alto Panorama to isolate compromised hosts

roles.title: Support Technician & Analyst
bullets: Administered endpoint security configurations, access controls, and MFA protocols across enterprise systems
Utilized SCCM and Intune for endpoint onboarding, automated patch management, and asset security tracking
Authored detailed technical KB articles and troubleshooting guides to standardize Tier 2 incident resolution

roles.title: IT Support Analyst & Technician
bullets: Managed endpoint deployment, user access management, and hardware troubleshooting in enterprise client environments
